notes.title: Patch 1.1 – New Features and Improvements
notes.notes:
The version 1.1 of the Heart of Gaia DEMO brings the following changes:

New boss added: Face a new challenge and test your combat skills.

New area.

Additional scenes: Discover more of the game's story with new scenes.

Rebalancing of early enemies:

Goblin

Goblin Archer

Hobgoblin

Bug fixes: Various adjustments to improve the gameplay experience.

Get ready for new adventures and refined combat!
